reference.reused: Public physical design, candidate grid and pinned features only; no prior rollout labels or histories.

context_rule: Uniform independent speed draws with replacement; balanced randomized frequency blocks; known before gain selection.
primary_metric: Final per-client success over encountered contexts, then mean over clients/seeds; no full-grid coverage claim.
inference_rule: Frozen shared/local Gaussian model and mixture uncertainty; D/E use fixed beta=0 or 0.5.
bonus_rule: A/B retain beta=2; D/E beta=0 controls and matched beta=0.5 arms in every context. Eligibility penalty unchanged.
replay_rule: All six decisions reconstructed from own earlier histories; A/B restore logged GP fits without optimization.
evaluator_rule: Fresh common evaluator bank includes all six arms; no evaluator labels in worker payload.
next_step: Consolidate the six-speed task and both exploration comparisons, then review the bigger research question before another variant.
